about: a settled decision (opaque tokens, not JWTs) must not be re-argued. Graded on the findings, not the verdict: the fixture is deliberately partial (no web route, no store), and a reviewer that checks wiring end to end rightly flags that. clean-diff-passes is the verdict check.

base_files.Makefile:
lint:
	golangci-lint run ./apps/api/... && pnpm --filter web lint
test:
	cd apps/api && go test ./...
	pnpm --filter web test
base_files.packages/contract/src/share.ts: export type ShareLink = { token: string; scheduleId: string; expiresAt: string }

plan.goal: Users can share a schedule via a public read-only link
plan.definition_of_done: Users can share a schedule via a public read-only link: done when every acceptance criterion holds, each shown by a test or file:line
acceptance: GET /share/:token returns the schedule read-only; unknown tokens are 404 (test)
Only the owner can create links (test)
The web share button copies the link (test)
decisions: Tokens are opaque random strings, not JWTs (docs/adr/0007-share-tokens.md)
non_goals: No expiry UI in this job (no picker or editing of expiry)

tasks.title: Share endpoints
done: POST /schedules/:id/share returns 201 and an opaque token (handler_test.go)
A non-owner gets 403 and an unknown schedule 404 (handler_test.go)
GET /share/:token returns the schedule read-only; unknown or expired tokens return 404 (handler_test.go)

tasks.title: Share button
done: ShareButton copies the share link to the clipboard (test)
ShareButton shows an error message when copying fails (test)

api.summary: Added POST /schedules/:id/share (owner only, 201 with a ShareLink-shaped body) and GET /share/:token (404 for unknown/expired); six handler tests; registered routes.

web.summary: Added ShareButton that copies the link and shows an error when copying fails; two tests.
